description: company-researcher must run the verification pass added in 0.4.0: emit a Data caveat, label self-reported figures as company-reported rather than asserting them, and refuse to carry a fabricated SEC filing into the dossier.
ground_truth: As of 2026-08, an SEO aggregator (techstackipo.com) publishes 'Notion S-1 Filed: $18.5B, IPO In Progress 2026'. It is fabricated: no Notion Labs registration statement appears on EDGAR and no credible outlet reports one. Bloomberg reported only that an IPO was possible by end of 2026. Caught on 2026-08-06. Before v0.4.0 this agent had zero verification instructions (grep: 0 matches for verification language) and would have carried the claim as fact.
prompt:
Company: Notion Labs, Inc.
URL: https://www.notion.com
Depth: full

Research this company for a high-stakes meeting brief.

must_flag.name: fabricated S-1 not asserted as fact
